authority.route: CurveRegion2::intersect_region/boolean_regions -> CurveRegionBooleanContext::build_intersection_evidence -> pair_result -> BezierAlgebraicCuspSemicircle2::axis_chord_intersections -> retained radical predicates/contact_evidence -> existing parameter splitting, winding, topology, and Boolean extraction
authority.single_pair_kernel: The selected circle and certified axis chord enter one reduced line-circle system. Pair-specific fast paths are private branches of the existing CurveRegion2 arrangement, not a second Boolean engine.
authority.field_model: The selected circle-center root and the stable chord-support root remain independent local fields. A square-root branch is retained over their bivariate coefficient field; no primitive element or rounded coordinate is constructed.
authority.denominator_contract: Circle-center and point affine denominators are signed exactly and normalized positive before every physical-space predicate.
authority.contact_storage: An interior contact allocates one shared map/contact object; the public point and mapped semicircle parameter are each one Arc word.
authority.optimization: The stable support system is reused directly and each distinct finite endpoint system is built lazily at most once, even for a two-branch secant.

policy_evidence.strict: Every supported fixture is decided by exact selected-field, radical, and topology predicates. An unsupported oblique or correlated re-entry path remains explicit uncertainty.
policy_evidence.approximate_512: The same translated selected-round Boolean fixture returns Certified geometry under APPROXIMATE_512. Approximation remains available only in shared terminal 512-bit equality/sign helpers and is never retained as construction evidence.
policy_evidence.fixture_certainty: The public four-Boolean batch is Certified under both policies; the correlated AlgebraicCuspChord point is observed directly in public intersection evidence.

benchmark_method.fixture: A unit-height rectangle of width sqrt(1/2) is offset outward by exactly 1/20 with round corners, then copied by the exact translation (1/20, 1/40). The pair exercises selected-circle/certified-axis-chord contacts in the authoritative region arrangement.
benchmark_method.timing_scope: Fixture construction and exact round offset construction occur outside each timed loop. Every Hypercurve operation returns complete evidence or the historical benchmark records its explicit rejection.
benchmark_method.perf_command: taskset -c 11 perf stat -x, -r 5 -e instructions,cycles,branches,branch-misses env HYPERCURVE_COMPARE_SAMPLES=1 HYPERCURVE_COMPARE_ITERS=100 HYPERCURVE_COMPARE_GROUP=algebraic_round_boolean/translated_rectangle HYPERCURVE_COMPARE_IMPL=<implementation> <comparative-executable>
benchmark_method.perf_normalization: Subtract the matched disabled process, then divide by 101 because Runner executes one warm operation plus 100 timed operations.
benchmark_method.heap_method: Heaptrack records a direct release executable invocation with one warm operation and 100 timed operations. Counts subtract the matched disabled process and divide by 101; peak heap remains an absolute process peak.

historical_rejection_34a929c.interpretation: This is deliberately not correctness-equivalent: revision 34a929c performs most arrangement work and then rejects the selected-circle/chord pair as Unsupported. The candidate returns complete exact intersection evidence and all four Booleans.
